entries.label: Late May 2011

entries.label: April 8, 2024 — US WALOVI brand identity
entries.evidence: Wanglaoji introduced its WALOVI English-language brand identity in Los Angeles on April 8, 2024. This dates the US identity shown on this product, not the original herbal recipe, canned product or first sale of this 24-can pack.

entries.label: 2012 — Jia Duo Bao rebranding
entries.evidence: The herbal tea was rebranded Jia Duo Bao in 2012. This dates the current product identity, not the original herbal recipe or this US multipack. The exact day is not established.
entries.title: 2013 account of Jia Duo Bao 2012 rebranding

entries.evidence: Wahaha AD calcium milk launched in 1996. This is product-family history; the exact launch day and current US 24-bottle pack date are not established.

entries.label: June 1988 — Beijing consumer introduction
entries.evidence: A contemporary Xinhua report published in People’s Daily describes this coconut drink first being presented to Beijing consumers in June 1988. The exact day and current 1-liter packaging launch are not established. June 3 was a technical certification date, not a verified launch day.
entries.title: People’s Daily / Xinhua: Hainan Coconut King, January 18, 1990

entries.evidence: White Rabbit milk candy first reached the market under that brand in 1959. Its predecessor dates to 1943; that is not the White Rabbit brand launch. The exact day and current retail pack date are not established.
entries.title: Shanghai government history of White Rabbit candy

entries.label: 2014 — Konjac Shuang product line
entries.evidence: Weilong’s overseas product brochure dates the Konjac Shuang line launch to 2014. This is a product-family estimate for the fragrant spicy variant; its exact flavor debut and current US pack launch are not established.
entries.title: Weilong overseas product brochure, history timeline

entries.evidence: Want Want’s North American operator history dates both Senbei and Shelly Senbei to 1983 in Taiwan. The exact day and current US five-pack launch are not established.

entries.label: Late 1999 — ChaCha sunflower-seed line
entries.evidence: ChaCha’s Canadian distributor dates the new ChaCha sunflower-seed product to late 1999. This is a product-family estimate; the exact roasted-and-salted variant debut and current US bulk-case launch are not established.
